articles.summary: Maybe you've made your own flaxseed gel in your kitchen. Maybe you've heard about its wonders, but never had the time to try it yourself. Or maybe you've never heard of flaxseed gel, but have been stuck with styling products that don't work or leave your hair dry. We heard you and have good news! You wanted a natural alternative to gels and edge controls, without the mess, inconvenience, or inconsistent results. So we hand-made flaxseed gel and used it to make the best gel and edge control on the market. Your hair has been waiting for this! Introducing NaturAll Club's Flaxseed Styling Collection We combined the nutrients, strength, and moisture of pure flaxseed gel, with our Yogurt Powder, the next generation of milk ingredients. This powdered version of yogurt contains nutrients such as non-hydrolyzed proteins, peptides, dairy lipids, vitamins, and minerals. Our unique blend of handcrafted flaxseed gel and Yogurt Powder improves the quality of dry hair and combing power on wet hair. Why Flax? ELASTICITY. Flaxseed is one of the best natural sources of omega-3 fatty acids. These compounds moisturize and protect hair. They improve elasticity and prevent breakage. HEALTHY SCALP. Omega-3s also help soothe and nourish the scalp, and can help prevent scalp conditions like dandruff and itchy scalp. REPAIR AND GROWTH. Flax is rich in antioxidants, which repair damaged hair follicles, prevent tissue corrosion, and keep your follicles healthy- creating a hospitable environment for new hair growth. STRENGTH Did you know your hair is made out of protein? Without protein, hair becomes weak and brittle. Flax is an excellent source of protein, so it will help maintain strong natural hair. HOLD AND DEFINITION. Our flaxseed gel defines and moisturizes curly and kinky hair without creating stiffness or crunchiness. It provides great hold and is flake free! The Products Flexible and Extreme Hold Curl Defining Flaxseed Gels with Yogurt Our handcrafted Flaxseed Gels keep hair healthy while delivering amazing hold. Our extreme and flexible hold formulas both leave hair soft, crunch free, and allow for flawless wash 'n go’s, twists, and braid out styles. Each 8oz Flaxseed Gel sells for $23. Order NOW! All-Day and 24-Hour Hold Flaxseed Edge Controls with Yogurt Our cutting edge Flaxseed Edge Controls deliver 24 hour hold, healthy shine, and tame frizzy hair. Choose flexible or extreme hold to smooth your edges, manage flyaways, and reveal effortless laid-back edges that last. Each 4oz Edge Control sells for $19. Order NOW! Styling Flaxseed Gel Curl Custard with Yogurt NaturAll Club's Styling Flaxseed Gel Curl Custard is a rich, lightweight leave-in styler. This non-sticky formula helps to soften hair, and gives a medium hold that is great for daily application. Our Flaxseed Gel Curl Custard sells for $23. Order NOW! Early feedback... Read some testimonials from our early customer testing!
